description: This file implements FA4 flash attention kernels registration and support functions for CUDA in PyTorch, including forward and backward passes, error checking, and module import handling.

classes.name: _FA4Handle
classes.description: Data class representing a handle for FA4 registration, with a method to remove the library reference.

methods.name: register_flash_attention_fa4
methods.description: Registers FA4 flash attention kernels with PyTorch dispatcher, setting module path and returning a handle.

methods.name: _fa4_import_module
methods.description: Imports the specified FA4 module and verifies it exposes required kernels.

methods.name: _fa4_register_kernels
methods.description: Creates and registers CUDA implementations of FA4 attention kernels in a PyTorch library.

methods.name: _fa4_common_support_error
methods.description: Checks common support conditions for FA4, such as CUDA tensors, device sharing, dtype, and compute capability.

methods.name: _fa4_forward_support_error
methods.description: Checks support conditions specific to FA4 forward pass, including dropout, debug mask, and sequence types.

methods.name: _fa4_backward_support_error
methods.description: Checks support conditions specific to FA4 backward pass, including dropout and windowed attention.

methods.name: _transpose_dense
methods.description: Transposes tensors for FA4 kernel compatibility.

methods.name: _fa4_run_forward
methods.description: Executes the FA4 forward kernel with provided tensors and parameters.

methods.name: _fa4_run_backward
methods.description: Executes the FA4 backward kernel with provided tensors and parameters.

methods.name: _fa4_flash_attention_forward_impl
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of FA4 flash attention, including support checks and kernel invocation.

methods.name: _fa4_flash_attention_backward_impl
methods.description: Performs the backward pass of FA4 flash attention, including support checks and kernel invocation.

methods.name: _fa4_scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_forward_impl
methods.description: Performs scaled dot-product FA4 forward pass with support checks and tensor transpositions.

methods.name: _fa4_scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_backward_impl
methods.description: Performs scaled dot-product FA4 backward pass with support checks and tensor transpositions.
